remarks: Located on a quiet, tree-lined street in coveted North Glenora, this impressive build blends timeless elegance w/ exceptional craftsmanship. Spanning over 3,100SF of finished living space, this 4 bedroom, 3.5 bathroom home has been thoughtfully designed w/ warm tones & inviting finishes that will stand the test of time. The main floor feat. 10' ceilings, floor-to-ceiling windows, a freestanding gas fireplace anchored by a brick feature wall & a chef-inspired kitchen. Wood cabinetry, Kohler fixtures & tiled baseboards in all bathrooms are carried throughout the home, reflecting the thoughtful design & attention to detail found in every space. Upstairs, the stunning primary retreat offers coffered ceilings, a walk-through closet to the laundry room, & a spa-like ensuite w/ a Zellige-inspired tiled shower, standalone soaker tub & tree-lined views. The extended basement adds over 1,000SF of living space complete w/ a built-in bar, while the 24'x12' rear concrete deck creates the perfect outdoor retreat. (id:67522)
